title: Aussie Aye Eye
style: Comedy pop with Aussie folk-polka bounce, skippy syncopation, and cheeky beatbox groove; verse 1 introduces Corey’s smart-eye scheme, verse 2 lets Michelle, Ruby, and Wez trade rapid-fire bits, pre-chorus tightens to gang chants, chorus lands on “aussie aussie aussie” with shouted replies. Four distinct vocal colors, stacked doubles, call-and-response ad-libs, Spanish lick tags, and playful group harmonies. Harmonica flares, fast guitar licks, magpie-swoop risers, and a bright punchy mix with cheeky low-end thump., comedy, bounce, polka, oi, happy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Aussie aussie aussie
Here aha here
Oi oi oi ha ha ha
Aussie, aussie, aussie

[Verse 1]
[Corey]
Corey happy, smart core
Corey A I eye, eye sees all
Hawk eye in the sky
Forward, back, reverse it twice
Super intelligence, tidy as pie
Pelican is what we reckon
Quokka, otter, galah
I spot the trick, I clock the lot

[Mishy]
Mishy Mish Mash
Pickle ball smash
Pink drink thinks
Pink milk drink, splash

[Pre-Chorus]
[Aussie Quartet]
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, aye i i
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie
Here aha here, we fly

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie
Oi oi oi
Aussie aussie aussie
Ha ha ha, boy
Aussie aussie aussie
Roo roo roo
Aussie aussie aussie
We laugh it through

[Verse 2]
[Ruby]
Girl kid stylist artist, Ruby
Roo roo, paint that sleeve
Pink ribbon on the sneakers
Tiny stars on the cuff, believe

[Wez]
Boy kid Wesley Coda Decoder
Wez, Wezza, crack that code
Micha’s off she goes
Super dog speed, down the road

[Ruby]
Spanish lick, ¡vamos!
Shiny grin, ¡qué bueno!
[Wez]
English plus español
We go quick, rápido, lento

[Bridge]
[Corey]
A I eye, I see the plan
Reversing, forwarding, clever hands
[Michelle]
Pelican, quokka, otter, galah
We make the whole room understand
[All]
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie
Here aha here
Mi mini black sniffer poodle
Turn up and disappear

[Final Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie
Oi oi oi
Aussie aussie aussie
Ha ha ha, boy
Aussie aussie aussie
Roo roo roo
Aussie aussie aussie
We laugh it through

[Outro]
Magpie swoop, we duck and dance
Harmonica yells, then one more chance
Aussie aussie aussie
Here aha here
Aussie, aussie, aussie
Yeah, mate, cheers
